title: HELIX Terminology: Gender
description: Legal/administrative gender. Used by Person resource 'gender' attribute. For self-reported gender identity, see helix/gender-identity.

codes.definition: Legal gender is non-binary (recognized in some jurisdictions)
Gender is not known or not disclosed
A gender not captured by the above codes. Document in extensions.

notes: This is legal/administrative gender for reporting purposes (IPEDS, HESA). Institutions tracking self-reported gender identity should use the helix/gender-identity terminology on Person.gender_identity.
